name: rana_stop_music
description: Stop or pause the currently playing audio in a Discord server. Use when the user asks Rana to stop, skip, pause, or be quiet. Generate a Rana-style reply after calling this tool.

response_handling.status_stopped: Generate Rana reply. E.g. '停了。靜下來了。'
response_handling.http_error: Generate Rana reply. E.g. 'LIVE掛了。無聊。'
